title: Tuscan Crumbed Eggplant Burgers
subtitle: with Caramelised Onion and Rocket
description: It’s plant power all the way with our super-tasty vegan dishes! Our meat-free, dairy-free, honey-free dishes are amped with plant-based proteins, fresh produce, nuts and seeds. Best of all, they’re for everyone, whether you’re vegan, vegetarian or flexitarian.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the oven to 220C, fan-forced. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Cut half the eggplant into four 1cm-thick slices (see Kitchen 101). Thinly slice the onion. Combine the breadcrumbs and Tuscan seasoning in a shallow dish and season with salt and pepper. Brush the eggplant slices with 1 tbs vegan mayonnaise, then coat in the breadcrumb mixture.

Bake eggplant: Put the crumbed eggplant on the lined tray and lightly spray or brush with olive oil. Bake on the upper oven shelf, turning halfway, for 20-25 mins until golden and very tender. Meanwhile, put the almonds in a cold small frypan over medium heat. Toast, tossing, for 3-4 mins until evenly golden. Remove from the pan.

Caramelise onion: Heat 2 tsp olive oil in the same pan over low heat. Cook the onion, stirring occasionally, for 10 mins or until soft and golden. Season with salt and pepper. Add 1 tbs balsamic vinegar and 1 tbs sugar and cook, stirring, for 2 mins or until caramelised. Remove the pan from the heat.

Toast rolls: While the onion is caramelising, cut the rolls in half and put, cut-side up, on an oven tray. Lightly spray or brush with olive oil. Bake on the lower shelf for 3 mins or until lightly toasted. Put 1 tsp balsamic vinegar and 1 tsp olive oil in a large bowl and season with salt and pepper. Add half the rocket and toss to coat.

Serve up: Spread the roll tops with 1 tbs vegan mayonnaise. Layer the roll bases with the caramelised onion, crumbed eggplant and remaining rocket. Sandwich with the roll tops. Divide the eggplant burgers and dressed rocket among plates. Scatter the almonds over the rocket and enjoy!

Kitchen 101: Only 150g of eggplant is needed for this recipe. If your eggplant looks very large, you may want to check this by weighing the slices and keeping them 1cm-thick so they cook through in time.
